meta.name: The Apprentice
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 513.11 MB

Poor Marvin needs your help! As apprentice to the great wizard Gandorf S. Wandburner III, Marvin must perform treacherous tasks throughout the castle towers. Take control of the apprentice and guide him through six heart-stopping levels in the arcade-style platform game that delivers fast, furious play with thousands of frames of animation. You'll be running, jumping, flying, even swimming your way around the towers, working against the clock and all the beastly enemies who are eager to prove that a wizard's work is never done!

meta.name: Flashback
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 78.92 MB

La historia comienza en 2042, cuando Conrad B. Hart se entera de un complot en el que participan alienígenas hostiles repartidos entre la población. Le secuestran pero Hart consigue escapar. Pronto es capturado y aterriza de emergencia en el corazón de la jungla de Titán, un satélite de Saturno. El jugador debe enfrentarse a los peligros de la jungla circundante y desbaratar la trama.
Aunque gran parte del juego consiste en correr, saltar y disparar a los enemigos, también hay un elemento considerable de exploración, así como algo de resolución de puzles. Conrad atraviesa estructuras de plataformas realizando distintos movimientos. Puede saltar, correr, trepar, agarrarse a salientes y recoger objetos...
Para defenderse, Conrad puede disparar a los enemigos con su pistola y utilizar diversos objetos para herirlos o distraerlos.

meta.name: Asterix : Caesar's Challenge
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 99.91 MB

This interactive board game offers action and adventure as Asterix and his friends journey around the Roman Empire on a challenge from Caesar while learning about different countries' history and culture. You can play as various characters including Asterix, Obelix, Impedimenta, Panacea, Justforkix and Geriatrix. You have to collect souvenirs from various places as proof you've been there, and then get back to your village in time or else Caesar will win. It allows for up to 4 players or you can play against the computer. The game track has 54 squares that can be landed on which represent countries, challenges, prisons, magic potions, traps, rest, and meeting character opportunities. 
The druid Getafix is host and will hand out magic potion flasks to players (except Obelix who, as fans of the comics know, fell into a potion when he was very young). You can acquire some interesting gadgets from the druid-spy Dubbelosix, that will help you move more quickly. To win the recquired souvenir items, you have to either answer the questions asked in the country squares or buy them from the Phoenician merchant Ekonomikrisis with sestertii won in challenge squares. The scoundrel Tortuous Convolvulus will also try to impede the players progress, so look out.

meta.name: Burn:Cycle
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 446.51 MB

Burn Cycle (stylized as Burn:Cycle) is a 1994 adventure video game for the CD-i that incorporates full motion video. The game's star, Sol Cutter, is a computer hacker and small-time data thief whose latest steal at the beginning of the game comes with a nasty sting. The Burn Cycle virus has been implanted in his head and has given him a two-hour realtime deadline to find a cure before his brain deteriorates completely. The player must guide Sol out of Softech and into the Televerse in order to find his cure. Various obstacles and games stand in his way, and there is the overarching realisation that Burn Cycle has been planted by someone with malicious intent.

meta.name: Earth Command - The Future Of Our World Is In Your Hands
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 423.57 MB

Earth Command es un juego de simulación estratégica centrado en las amenazas ecológicas y sociales que se ciernen sobre nuestro planeta. El jugador asume el papel de jefe de un puesto de mando especial de las Naciones Unidas en el espacio. Tiene pleno control para asignar presupuestos e impuestos, enviar ayuda de emergencia, decretar leyes de excepción y otras acciones de interés global. Deberás combatir tanto las catástrofes naturales como las sociales.
El juego se desarrolla en un mapa del mundo de arriba abajo. Cada vez que surge una situación se acompaña de vídeos en movimiento. El juego cubre 500 posibles emergencias en 130 países diferentes e incluye vídeos reales de, entre otros, CNN, Greenpeace y el Departamento de Estado de EE UU.

meta.name: Harvest Of The Sun Vincent Van Gogh Revisited
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 185.42 MB

"Harvest of the Sun" invites you on an extraordinary journey into the world of Vincent Van Gogh. You will discover every detail of his life and art in vibrant color and set to period music. On this CD, you are a critic like Theo Van Gogh, who was the painter's "agent," or a "connoisseur" like Doctor Gachet, who treated him. You decide the program yourself. Enter the painter's studio and pick up a painting, and you're off to Paris and the bustling streets of Montmartre, or to the sun-drenched plains of Provence. You will be able to visit the six main periods of Van Gogh's dramatic life at your own pace and whenever you please. Even more: you will be able to see the very places where the artist lived and worked, discover where he set up his easel, and understand how he observed a scene and reproduced it. In the music gallery, you will admire the work of Van Gogh with the accents of the music of Debussy, Frank, Chabrier and Bizet in a symphony of colors and digital sounds.

meta.name: Go
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 216.19 MB

Go: Special Edition is a digital version of the classic Chinese board game. The game is played with two players or against an AI. Like in the board game players take turns to place white or black markers on intersections of the game grid. The goal is to gain a majority control of the board. Players can remove an opponents markers by completely surrounding them with their own.
The game includes video tutorials from professional Go players and a complete history behind the game Go and a strategy guide.

Goal: FIFA World Cup Soccer Quiz Game is a quiz game about the FIFA World Cup. In the game two players play a match of soccer against each other. Depending on the player's choice he's presented with an easy, medium or hard multiple choice question about the World Cup event. Answering the question correctly makes the choice a success. More difficult questions have a greater benefit on the field. Players can choose for a game of five, ten or fifteen minutes.
